name: stacks
description: Adds support for the Stacks (STX) network, sBTC, and stBTC (SIP-010): derive STX addresses (m/44'/5757'/0'/0/0) or import watch-only addresses, view STX/sBTC/stBTC balances and running-balance history, and sign/broadcast STX, sBTC, and stBTC transfers.
author: Electrum Stacks Plugin Contributors
